exercises.instructions: Choose the correct form of 'to be' to complete each sentence.

questions.question: I ________ a student.
questions.explanation: With 'I', we use 'am'. 'I am' is the correct form of 'be' for first person singular. 'I' နဲ့ 'am' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She ________ happy today.
questions.explanation: With 'she', we use 'is'. 'She is' is the correct form of 'be' for third person singular. 'She' နဲ့ 'is' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: They ________ in the park now.
questions.explanation: With 'they', we use 'are'. 'They are' is the correct form of 'be' for third person plural. 'They' နဲ့ 'are' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: We ________ at school every day.
questions.explanation: With 'we', we use 'are'. 'We are' is the correct form of 'be' for first person plural. 'We' နဲ့ 'are' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: He ________ a doctor.
questions.explanation: With 'he', we use 'is'. 'He is' is the correct form of 'be' for third person singular. 'He' နဲ့ 'is' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: You ________ my friend.
questions.explanation: With 'you', we use 'are'. 'You are' is the correct form of 'be' for second person. 'You' နဲ့ 'are' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.answer: You will be late next time.
questions.explanation: With 'you' in future tense, we use 'will be'. 'Next time' indicates future time. 'You' နဲ့ အနာဂတ်ကာလမှာ 'will be' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: ကျွန်မ ဆရာဝန်မဟုတ်ဘူး။ (I / not / a doctor)
questions.explanation: With 'I', we use 'am not' for negative. 'I am not a doctor' is the correct translation. 'I' နဲ့ ငြင်းဆိုပုံ 'am not' ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: သူမ လှမဟုတ်ဘူး။ (She / not / beautiful)
questions.explanation: With 'she', we use 'is not' for negative. 'She is not beautiful' is the correct translation. 'She' နဲ့ ငြင်းဆိုပုံ 'is not' ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: သူတို့ အိမ်မှာ မရှိဘူး။ (They / not / at home)
questions.explanation: With 'they', we use 'are not' for negative. 'They are not at home' is the correct translation. 'They' နဲ့ ငြင်းဆိုပုံ 'are not' ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: ကျွန်မ ဆရာဝန်လား။ (I / a doctor)
questions.explanation: With 'I' in interrogative, we use 'Am I...?'. 'Am I a doctor?' is the correct translation. 'I' နဲ့ မေးခွန်းပုံ 'Am I...?' ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: သူ ဆရာလား။ (He / a teacher)
questions.explanation: With 'he' in interrogative, we use 'Is he...?'. 'Is he a teacher?' is the correct translation. 'He' နဲ့ မေးခွန်းပုံ 'Is he...?' ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: သူတို့ ပန်းခြံထဲမှာ ရှိလား။ (They / in the park)
questions.explanation: With 'they' in interrogative, we use 'Are they...?'. 'Are they in the park?' is the correct translation. 'They' နဲ့ မေးခွန်းပုံ 'Are they...?' ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။
